notes.title: New Doors Added
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659304/3aacbe94663399bc66ffc12f58640d9f56371a7d.gif"][/img]

Exploration in [i]Happy Door[/i] is a very important task.
Rather than simply wandering through random spaces in random maps,
I hope players can set their exploration routes proactively with a few clues,
then discover new hints during their journey and re-discuss strategies with their companions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659304/7cc4ac64b88287f31eea474155582ac65c9144c2.gif"][/img][/p][p]I expect players to understand the meaning each door carries, and play in a more strategic way.[/p]

notes.title: New Trailer
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the Happy Door development team.

We realized that our previous videos alone might not have fully conveyed what Happy Door is, why you should explore this place, or why magic cannot be used, so we have prepared a video introducing Happy Door in a rule‑based horror manual format.

As for development updates, we are currently implementing the magic and combat systems in the game.

To give you a brief development update, we are currently implementing the magic and combat systems in the game, and the spell‑casting scene in the new trailer is one of those features.

We always welcome feedback, so please feel free to share your valuable thoughts. 
Thank you![/p]

notes.title: New merchant character
notes.content: [p]She respawns randomly on the map[/p][p]and instantly exchanges items in the player’s inventory for gold.[/p][p]She is timid but adept at calculations.[/p][p]Modeling is in progress, so please look forward to it.[/p]
